name: Read Destiny entrypoint
command: set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca 'podman exec upload-assistant-wastaken sh -c "sed -n \"1,240p\" /usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh"'
description: Inspect the container entrypoint that is currently sleeping instead of serving Destiny’s WebUI.
